scope: Synthetic instruction-navigation smoke using shell/file access only; no vault operation was performed.

query.section: Retrieve only what the answer needs
query.first_action: Run kb map <query> with concise topic or heading terms, then select a relevant section node_id. For a narrow fact or named subsection, search those terms first.

ingest.first_action: Read the supplied source within the requested scope; use kb read-raw <filename> --approve for an archived source only when source access is authorized.

lint.first_action: Check required frontmatter, valid page types, dead links, missing backlinks, duplicate coverage, conflicting claims and stale evidence.

refine.first_action: Establish findings and proposed scope, such as corrections, useful connections, duplicate pages, merge/split candidates or backlink repairs.

extract.first_action: Run kb sessions --unprocessed and retain the returned full manifest filenames exactly.

observations.summary: All five entrypoints named the available kb skill; the supplied registry path resolved all four required guide files. Each applicable first operation action was identified without executing it.

limits: One agent host. Navigation only; no operation workflow or cross-harness performance claim.
